text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered: high HTTP 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway (service: inference-gateway-eu). alert_id=PD-98765. Initial signal: sustained 502/504 spike > 8% error-rate over 3m.
ryan: I'm on it, taking primary. acked via PD.
pagerduty-bot: ryan acknowledged the incident (rotation: sre-weekend). Escalation policy: SRE > Eng Oncall.
maria: seeing the spike dashboards — errors originating from eu-west1 front-proxy -> TLS handshake failures and early connection resets. Tail logs show lots of `TLS handshake error: EOF` from sidecar 172.* on newly-deployed proxy version.
lena: rolling back the proxy rollout to previous stable now (k8s revision 271 -> 270). `kubectl rollout undo deploy/front-proxy -n infra --to-revision=270` running.
raj: can you dump the last 5m of request traces to check if a specific customer or route is affected? link to traces: https://observability/redwood/traces?query=inference-gateway+eu-west1+502
maria: quick grep shows high concentration to route `/v1/generate` and a handful of 3rd-party IPs (load balancer IPs) showing repeated TLS errors. Not obviously customer-specific yet.
ryan: rollback in progress. hitting `kubectl rollout status` now. If rollback takes >2m we'll failover traffic to us-west as temporary mitigation.
lena: rollback completed on front-proxy, pods are back to revision 270. Confirming readiness checks passing. (logs: `front-proxy-270 Ready`)
maria: error rate dropped from 9.3% to 2.1% over the last 90s. Good sign.
ryan: leaving a canary window of 10m to watch. Adding traffic slice reroute to reduce eu-west1 load. Command: ```python
# reroute small fraction of eu-west1 traffic to us-west
curl -X POST "https://controlplane/api/traffic/slice" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"from":"eu-west1","to":"us-west1","pct":15}'
```
raj: FYI ran a quick KV cache sanity check — no widespread eviction or stampede. Latency p95 slightly elevated but within SLOs for now.
lena: customer-support flagged 2 enterprise customers with transient 502s. CS is pinged and holding.
ryan: adding note to incident timeline: probable root cause = buggy proxy sidecar rollout causing TLS handshake failures under certain connection patterns. Mitigation = rollback + traffic slice.
maria: will open an eval with the proxy team to add more aggressive health checks and a canary threshold for TLS errors.
pagerduty-bot: incident status: acknowledged -> mitigated. No further automatic escalations will be sent.
ryan: switching to monitoring-only. Oncall handoff at 02:00 UTC to lena (overnight). Lena, you good to take follow-ups?
lena: yep, I'll monitor for the next 3 hours and keep CS updated. If error-rate creeps back above 5% for >4m, I'll re-escalate.
raj: saving log slices and trace links to the incident artifact: https://artifacts/redwood/incidents/5861234567. Also saving `kubectl` commands used and rollout diff.
maria: quick checklist for follow-up: 1) postmortem-runbook with timeline and blame-free analysis, 2) add a pre-deploy TLS smoke test for proxy, 3) pin canary traffic to small samples and abort on >1% TLS handshake errors.
ryan: thanks all — I'll file the incident ticket and tag the proxy owners. Marking thread as incident-mitigated. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Incident ID PD-98765 -> postmortem requested.
